name: Heidi Health
summary: AI medical scribe with a free plan, plus evidence and desktop dictation tools for clinicians.
description: Heidi Health is an AI scribe that listens to consultations and drafts notes, letters and documents, and adds evidence answers during visits. Its desktop app captures telehealth audio and dictation anywhere on screen. The Free plan includes unlimited ambient documentation; paid tiers add evidence and other features, with Max at $110 per user per month, and enterprise plans are available.

howToUse.title: Open Heidi Health
howToUse.description: Open Heidi Health and choose Get Heidi free, or download the desktop app for macOS or Windows. Book a demo if a health system needs a walkthrough.

howToUse.title: Let the scribe draft the visit
howToUse.description: During a consultation, let the scribe listen and draft the note, then the letters and documents that follow. It can also add evidence answers during the visit.

howToUse.title: Dictate and capture telehealth audio
howToUse.description: In the desktop app, use dictation anywhere on the screen and capture telehealth audio straight from the call.

howToUse.title: Pick a documentation tier
howToUse.description: On the Free plan, ambient documentation has no cap. Paid tiers add evidence and further capabilities, Max costs $110 for each user every month, and enterprise plans can be arranged.
